description: This file defines functions and tables for converting hexadecimal strings into byte arrays, including utility functions for hex digit conversion, and an external lookup table.

methods.name: unsigned int hexval(unsigned char c)
methods.description: Inline function returning the numerical value of a hexadecimal character from the lookup table.

methods.name: int hex2chr(const char * s)
methods.description: Converts two hexadecimal characters into a single byte, returning a negative value on error.

methods.name: hex_to_bytes
methods.description: Converts a string of hexadecimal characters into a byte array.

ctags.name: hexval
ctags.pattern: /^static inline unsigned int hexval(unsigned char c)$/
